violations.affected_code: IconButton(icon: const Icon(Icons.close), iconSize: 16, padding: EdgeInsets.zero, constraints: const BoxConstraints(), style: const ButtonStyle(tapTargetSize: MaterialTapTargetSize.shrinkWrap), ...)
violations.explanation: The remove button has a 16px icon with zero padding, empty constraints and shrinkWrap tap target size, so its touch target is about 16x16 dp. This is far below the recommended minimum of 48x48 dp (Material) or 44x44 pt (WCAG 2.5.5/2.5.8 guidance). Users with motor impairments will struggle to activate it.
